name: powerbi-desktop-handbook
description: Version-aware Power BI Desktop visual catalog and offline handbook generator.

scripts.build: node plugins/powerbi-desktop-handbook/skills/powerbi-desktop-handbook/scripts/handbook.mjs build --manifest examples/sample-dashboard.json --output examples/sample-dashboard-guide.html --json && node plugins/powerbi-desktop-handbook/skills/powerbi-desktop-handbook/scripts/handbook.mjs build --manifest examples/executive-sales-dashboard.json --output examples/executive-sales-dashboard-guide.html --json
scripts.validate: node plugins/powerbi-desktop-handbook/skills/powerbi-desktop-handbook/scripts/handbook.mjs validate --manifest examples/sample-dashboard.json && node plugins/powerbi-desktop-handbook/skills/powerbi-desktop-handbook/scripts/handbook.mjs validate --manifest examples/executive-sales-dashboard.json
